title: Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces
abstract: arXiv:2610.18606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. translated_title: 超越答案投票：通过采样推理轨迹间的图对齐实现大语言模型推理的细粒度纠正
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地处理需要多步推理的任务，其中中间声明的错误可能会影响最终答案。自洽性通过 对采样的最终答案进行投票来改进推理，但其投票无法解决中间步骤的分歧。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了DDRG（基于推理图的分歧驱动验证），一个从冻结的推理轨迹库中进行选择性纠正的框架。我们的核心洞察是：图对齐能够暴露声明层面的分歧，并在无需扩大采样轨迹库的情况下提供纠正证据。DDRG 构建基于来源依据的声明图，并将局部冲突发送给一个不感知答案的验证器。当验证器支持的驳斥能够触及多数答案的支持路径时，触发一次聚焦式修复；否则，DDRG 返回精确的 SC 投票结果。在五个基准测试上的实验结果表明，原生零样本的 DDRG 在……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出DDRG框架，利用采样推理轨迹间的图对齐暴露声明层面的分歧，并通过答案盲验证器实现选择性聚焦修复，从而在不扩大采样规模的前提下超越仅依赖最终答案投票的自洽性方法。
en_tdlr: DDRG leverages graph alignment across sampled reasoning traces to expose claim-level disagreements and performs selective, verifier-guided focused repairs, going beyond answer-level voting in self-consistency without expanding the sampled trace bank.
